description: Persist a one-paragraph memory of where THIS agent stands on the given thread. Called at the end of every wake — Claude Code reads it back into the next wake's prompt so the agent doesn't re-derive context from scratch by re-reading 10 prior messages. Pass `threadId` from `get_thread_id`. Fields are a snapshot: summary (where the thread stands), commitments (what you committed to), openQuestions (what you are blocked on), lastAction (what you just did), lastUid (newest UID you have digested). The file overwrites; you do not need to merge with the previous version — the dispatcher reads only the most recent write.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

commitments.description: Things you have committed to doing on this thread.

lastAction.description: The last action you took on the thread (e.g. "replied UID 41 asking for raw counts").

lastUid.description: Newest message UID you have digested into this memory.

openQuestions.description: Things you are waiting on / open questions.

summary.description: One-paragraph narrative of where the thread stands.

threadId.description: Stable thread id from get_thread_id. Required.

name: save_thread_memory
